name: Vampire Lover
source:
Suddenly, people in 2025 are turning into vampires. The state responds with street bans and lethal enforcement.

Moira is taken in by her girlfriend Valerie – unaware Valerie hunts her kind. Can Valerie keep her secret? What happens when Moira learns the truth?

[From [url=https://effie-calcarina.itch.io/vampire-lover]Itch.io[/url]]
